assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key areas are provisional_constraint from provisional_boundaries.geojson; official_boundary=false.
assumptions.impact: Areas and topology are for generation, visualization, and self-check only; recalculate all layers and metrics after official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Known metrics use full-precision JSON values; human-facing figures and prose use rounded display (~3 significant figures) to avoid misleading precision on provisional geometry.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers must treat metrics.json as authoritative; rounded figures in proposal/PDF/HTML are illustrative only.

assumptions.statement: Event capacities, KPI targets, RACI roles, and appeal channels are conceptual placeholders for professional/operator handover, not approved operations.
assumptions.impact: Operations content supports transferability scoring only; cannot be cited as government or enterprise commitments.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility, night safety, and non-digital alternatives are concept checklists only; no compliance certification is claimed.
assumptions.impact: Inclusive design requires professional accessibility audit against applicable standards before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Regional synergy interfaces with Beiwei Community, Future Sci-City, Huairou, E-Town, and Jing-Jin-Ji are conceptual coordination ideas, not signed inter-jurisdictional agreements.
assumptions.impact: Spatial and operational linkages must be confirmed with responsible agencies before any public commitment.
